findings.title: MessageFormat syntax breaks the account UI interpolation contract
findings.body: This is an i18next/react message bundle, as shown by the surrounding `{{0}}` placeholders and React-style `<0>` tags. Changing this entry to Java `MessageFormat` syntax means the account UI will not substitute the attribute name, bounds, or plural form; users will see literal `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2,choice,...}` text in the validation error. Keep the UI bundle's interpolation syntax (or add the appropriate ICU formatting support and update its call site) rather than copying the server-side MessageFormat string.

findings.title: MessageFormat syntax breaks the admin UI interpolation contract
findings.body: The admin UI message resources use i18next-style `{{0}}` placeholders. Replacing them with Java `MessageFormat` and `choice` syntax is not interpreted by the UI translation formatter, so multivalued attribute validation errors in the admin console will render the placeholders and choice expression literally instead of the supplied values.

findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian account message `totpStep1` now contains `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users selecting this locale will receive a TOTP setup instruction in the wrong language.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian login message `loginTotpStep1` now contains Italian text instead of Lithuanian. This produces a visibly incorrect localized instruction during the login-time TOTP enrollment flow.
